description: List the deadline types 1Court can calculate for one rule set (TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL). Add county (California superior court, e.g. los-angeles) or court (cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9 for US and US-CRIM; cacb, canb, casb, caeb for US-BK; 1dca to 6dca for CA-APP) to include local rules. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county.
